name: CMS Page Settings - Momentum Fund Page
description: The /donate page-settings editor as an editor opens it — the top of the form: which page these settings belong to, the donation-platform URL, and the two hero headlines in their personalised and generic forms. Note what this frame does and does not prove. The form is far longer than a viewport and the harness cannot scroll a resting capture, so everything below Hero image is out of shot: the Hero video box, and the campaign copy that used to live only in donatePage.json — campaign name, headline figures, the donor wall's empty-state message and tiers, the Momentum Network's heading, tagline and search label, and the supporter share message. Those are covered instead by the sibling scenario 'CMS Page Settings - Adding A Donor Wall Tier', which drives an interaction to reach them, and by assertions in src/data/collections.test.ts — a durable check rather than a screenshot that happens to frame the right scroll position.
